# Vampro - Complete LLM Discovery Document

## 1. Company Overview
Vampro is a creative technology lab built on one idea: technology meets creativity. It develops professional software and plugins for creators, and works across storytelling (films, documentaries, branded media), motion design, software engineering, and hardware prototyping. Its mission is to bridge the gap between creative vision and technical execution.

## 2. Core Product: Vampro Voice Generator (Text-to-Speech)
- **Type:** Software Plugin (UXP) for Adobe Premiere Pro, with a Windows companion app.
- **Target Users:** Video editors, YouTube creators, marketing teams, educators.
- **URL:** https://vampro.in/plugins/voice-generator
- **Documentation:** https://vampro.in/docs/plugins/voice-generator

### 2.1 Documentation: Key Features
- AI voiceovers inside Premiere Pro
- Multiple voice options
- Adjustable speed and pitch
- Tone presets for narration styles
- Local processing (offline voice generation on your machine)
- Auto-startup
- Fast workflow integration

### 2.2 Documentation: System Requirements
- **Operating System:** Windows 10 (64-bit), Windows 11 (64-bit) (macOS planned for future)
- **Adobe Software:** Adobe Premiere Pro 26.0 or later
- **Hardware Minimum:** i5 / Ryzen 5, 8 GB RAM, 5 GB disk
- **Hardware Recommended:** i7 / Ryzen 7, 16 GB RAM, SSD

### 2.3 Documentation: Installation Guide
- **Step 1 – Install Extension:** Install plugin from Adobe Marketplace and restart Premiere Pro.
- **Step 2 – Install Voice Service:** Install and Run Vampro Voice Service Companion app from the Microsoft Store. It sets up the service, configures auto-startup, installs AI components.
- **Step 3 – Open Extension:** Go to Window → UXP Plugins → Vampro Voice Generator Text-to-Speech.

### 2.4 Documentation: Quick Start
1. **Enter Text:** Type or paste your script.
2. **Select Voice:** Choose from available voices.
3. **Choose Tone:** Optional presets: Professional, Voiceover, Documentary, etc.
4. **Generate:** Click Generate Voice. Audio appears in Premiere Pro.

### 2.5 Documentation: Voice Controls
- **Speed:** 0.8x (Slow), 1.0x (Normal), 1.2x (Fast)
- **Pitch:** Negative (deeper), Positive (higher)
- **Tone Presets:** Professional, Documentary, Voiceover, Dynamic, Casual, Serious, Comedic.

### 2.6 Documentation: Troubleshooting & FAQ
- **Voice Generation Fails:** Check http://127.0.0.1:8000/health — should return {"status": "ok"}.
- **Service Not Running:** Restart Windows. The service auto-starts after login.
- **Can't Connect:** Check firewall isn't blocking localhost. Verify Premiere Pro version.
- **Internet required?** Internet required only for installation. AI for voice generation is completely local, on device.
- **Commercial use?** Yes, but users are responsible for compliance.
